+ import { Muxer, ArrayBufferTarget } from 'mp4-muxer';

+ export class ASCIIVideoExportService {

+   /**
+    * Export ASCII frames to MP4 video.

+   async exportVideo(

+     options: ExportOptions,

+     onProgress?: (progress: number) =&gt; void,
+     originalFile?: File | null
+   ): Promise&lt;Blob&gt; {
+     console.log('[ASCIIExport] Starting MP4 export...');
+     console.log(&#96;[ASCIIExport] ${frames.length} frames @ ${options.frameRate}fps, canvas ${canvas.width}x${canvas.height}&#96;);
+ 
+     // Ensure dimensions are even (H.264 requirement)
+     canvas.width = Math.ceil(canvas.width / 2) * 2;
+     canvas.height = Math.ceil(canvas.height / 2) * 2;
+ 
+     // ── Primary: WebCodecs + mp4-muxer ──
+     if (typeof VideoEncoder !== 'undefined') {
+       try {
+         const videoBlob = await this.encodeWithWebCodecs(
+           frames, canvas, ctx, options, renderFrame, onProgress
+         );
+ 
+         if (videoBlob.size === 0) {
+           throw new Error('Encoded video is empty');
+         }
+ 
+         // Mux audio from original if available
+         if (originalFile) {
+           try {
+             console.log('[ASCIIExport] Muxing audio from original...');
+             const finalBlob = await this.muxAudioWithFFmpeg(videoBlob, originalFile, onProgress);
+             if (finalBlob.size &gt; 0) return finalBlob;
+           } catch (audioErr) {
+             console.warn('[ASCIIExport] Audio muxing failed, returning video-only MP4:', audioErr);
+           }

+ 
+         return videoBlob;
+       } catch (webCodecsErr) {
+         console.warn('[ASCIIExport] WebCodecs encode failed, trying FFmpeg:', webCodecsErr);
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     // ── Fallback: Full FFmpeg WASM ──
+     return this.encodeWithFFmpeg(frames, canvas, ctx, options, renderFrame, onProgress, originalFile);
+   }
+ 
+   // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
+   // WebCodecs + mp4-muxer (primary path)
+   // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
+   private async encodeWithWebCodecs(
+     frames: ASCIIFrameData[],
+     canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
+     ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
+     options: ExportOptions,
+     renderFrame: Function,
+     onProgress?: (progress: number) =&gt; void
+   ): Promise&lt;Blob&gt; {

+     const frameDurationUs = Math.round(1_000_000 / fps);

+     // Find a supported H.264 codec
+     const codecs = ['avc1.42001f', 'avc1.4d001f', 'avc1.640028', 'avc1.420034'];
+     let chosenCodec = '';

+     for (const codec of codecs) {

+           height,

+           framerate: fps,

+

+             else setTimeout(check, 5);
+           };
+           check();
+         });
+       }
+ 
+       if (onProgress) {

+       }

+   // FFmpeg: mux audio from original into video-only MP4
+   // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
+   private async muxAudioWithFFmpeg(
+     videoBlob: Blob,
+     originalFile: File,
+     onProgress?: (progress: number) =&gt; void
+   ): Promise&lt;Blob&gt; {
+     await this.loadFFmpeg();
+     const ffmpeg = this.ffmpeg!;
+ 
+     try {
+       const videoData = await fetchFile(videoBlob);
+       await ffmpeg.writeFile('video_only.mp4', videoData);
+ 
+       const originalData = await fetchFile(originalFile);
+       await ffmpeg.writeFile('original.mp4', originalData);
+ 
+       // Copy video stream, encode audio from original
+       await ffmpeg.exec([
+         '-i', 'video_only.mp4',
+         '-i', 'original.mp4',
+         '-map', '0:v',        // Video from our encoded MP4
+         '-map', '1:a?',       // Audio from original (? = optional)
+         '-c:v', 'copy',       // Copy video — no re-encoding!
+         '-c:a', 'aac',
+         '-b:a', '128k',
+         '-shortest',          // Match to shortest stream
+         '-movflags', '+faststart',
+         'output_final.mp4'
+       ]);
+ 
+       const data = await ffmpeg.readFile('output_final.mp4');
+       const finalBlob = new Blob([data], { type: 'video/mp4' });
+ 
+       console.log(&#96;[ASCIIExport] Audio muxed successfully: ${(finalBlob.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB&#96;);
+ 
+       // Cleanup
+       try {
+         await ffmpeg.deleteFile('video_only.mp4');
+         await ffmpeg.deleteFile('original.mp4');
+         await ffmpeg.deleteFile('output_final.mp4');
+       } catch { /* ignore cleanup errors */ }
+ 
+       if (onProgress) onProgress(100);
+       return finalBlob;
+ 
+     } catch (error) {
+       try {
+         await ffmpeg.deleteFile('video_only.mp4');
+         await ffmpeg.deleteFile('original.mp4');
+         await ffmpeg.deleteFile('output_final.mp4');
+       } catch { /* ignore */ }
+       throw error;
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
+   // FFmpeg WASM: full encode fallback
+   // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
+   private async encodeWithFFmpeg(
+     frames: ASCIIFrameData[],
+     canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
+     ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
+     options: ExportOptions,
+     renderFrame: Function,
+     onProgress?: (progress: number) =&gt; void,
+     originalFile?: File | null
+   ): Promise&lt;Blob&gt; {
+     console.log('[ASCIIExport] Full FFmpeg WASM encode');
+     await this.loadFFmpeg();
+     const ffmpeg = this.ffmpeg!;
+ 
+     if (onProgress) {
+       ffmpeg.on('progress', ({ progress }) =&gt; {
+         onProgress(50 + progress * 50);
+       });
+     }
+ 
+     const frameCount = frames.length;
+     const padLength = Math.max(4, frameCount.toString().length);
+ 
+     try {
+       // Write frames as PNGs
+       for (let i = 0; i &lt; frameCount; i++) {
+         const frame = frames[i];
+         renderFrame(canvas, ctx, frame.ascii, frame.colors);
+ 
+         const blob = await new Promise&lt;Blob&gt;((resolve) =&gt; {
+           canvas.toBlob((b) =&gt; resolve(b!), 'image/png');
+         });
+ 
+         const data = await fetchFile(blob);
+         const num = i.toString().padStart(padLength, '0');
+         await ffmpeg.writeFile(&#96;frame_${num}.png&#96;, data);
+ 
+         if (onProgress) onProgress(Math.round((i / frameCount) * 50));
+       }
+ 
+       // Write original for audio extraction
+       let hasAudio = false;
+       if (originalFile) {
+         try {
+           const origData = await fetchFile(originalFile);
+           await ffmpeg.writeFile('original_input.mp4', origData);
+           hasAudio = true;
+         } catch (e) {
+           console.warn('[ASCIIExport] Could not write original for audio:', e);
+         }
+       }
+ 
+       const outputFile = 'output.mp4';
+ 
+       const ffmpegArgs = hasAudio ? [
+         '-framerate', options.frameRate.toString(),
+         '-i', &#96;frame_%0${padLength}d.png&#96;,
+         '-i', 'original_input.mp4',
+         '-map', '0:v', '-map', '1:a?',
+         '-c:v', 'libx264',
+         '-crf', this.getQualityCRF(options.quality || 'high'),
+         '-preset', 'fast',
+         '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p',
+         '-c:a', 'aac', '-b:a', '128k',
+         '-shortest',
+         '-movflags', '+faststart',
+         outputFile
+       ] : [
+         '-framerate', options.frameRate.toString(),
+         '-i', &#96;frame_%0${padLength}d.png&#96;,
+         '-c:v', 'libx264',
+         '-crf', this.getQualityCRF(options.quality || 'high'),
+         '-preset', 'fast',
+         '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p',
+         '-movflags', '+faststart',
+         outputFile
+       ];
+ 
+       console.log('[ASCIIExport] FFmpeg command:', ffmpegArgs.join(' '));
+       await ffmpeg.exec(ffmpegArgs);
+ 
+       const data = await ffmpeg.readFile(outputFile);
+       const outputBlob = new Blob([data], { type: 'video/mp4' });
+ 
+       console.log(&#96;[ASCIIExport] FFmpeg export done: ${(outputBlob.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB&#96;);
+       return outputBlob;
+ 
+     } finally {
+       // Cleanup temp files
+       try {
+         for (let i = 0; i &lt; frameCount; i++) {
+           const num = i.toString().padStart(padLength, '0');
+           try { await ffmpeg.deleteFile(&#96;frame_${num}.png&#96;); } catch { /* ignore */ }
+         }
+         try { await ffmpeg.deleteFile('output.mp4'); } catch { /* ignore */ }
+         try { await ffmpeg.deleteFile('original_input.mp4'); } catch { /* ignore */ }
+       } catch { /* ignore */ }
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
+   // FFmpeg loader with CDN fallback
+   // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
+   private async loadFFmpeg(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+     if (this.ffmpegLoaded &amp;&amp; this.ffmpeg) return;
+     if (this.ffmpegLoading) {
+       while (this.ffmpegLoading) await new Promise(r =&gt; setTimeout(r, 100));
+       if (this.ffmpegLoaded) return;
+       throw new Error('FFmpeg loading failed in another context');
+     }
+ 
+     this.ffmpegLoading = true;
+     this.ffmpeg = new FFmpeg();
+     this.ffmpeg.on('log', ({ message }) =&gt; console.log('[FFmpeg]', message));
+ 
+     try {
+       // Try multiple CDNs for resilience
+       const cdns = [
+         'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ffmpeg/core@0.12.6/dist/umd',
+         'https://unpkg.com/@ffmpeg/core@0.12.6/dist/umd',
+       ];
+ 
+       let loaded = false;
+       for (const baseURL of cdns) {
+         try {
+           console.log(&#96;[ASCIIExport] Trying CDN: ${baseURL}&#96;);
+           await this.ffmpeg.load({
+             coreURL: await toBlobURL(&#96;${baseURL}/ffmpeg-core.js&#96;, 'text/javascript'),
+             wasmURL: await toBlobURL(&#96;${baseURL}/ffmpeg-core.wasm&#96;, 'application/wasm'),
+           });
+           loaded = true;
+           console.log(&#96;[ASCIIExport] FFmpeg loaded from ${baseURL}&#96;);
+           break;
+         } catch (e) {
+           console.warn(&#96;[ASCIIExport] CDN failed (${baseURL}):&#96;, e);
+         }
+       }
+ 
+       if (!loaded) throw new Error('FFmpeg could not be loaded from any CDN');
+       this.ffmpegLoaded = true;
+ 
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('[ASCIIExport] FFmpeg loading failed:', error);
+       this.ffmpeg = null;
+       throw new Error(&#96;FFmpeg loading failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}&#96;);
+     } finally {
+       this.ffmpegLoading = false;
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   // ── Helpers ──
+   private getBitrate(quality: string): number {
+     const map: Record&lt;string, number&gt; = {
+       low: 1_500_000,
+       medium: 3_000_000,
+       high: 5_000_000,
+       ultra: 10_000_000,
+     };
+     return map[quality] || 5_000_000;
+   }
+ 
+   private getQualityCRF(quality: string): string {
+     const map: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = { low: '28', medium: '23', high: '18', ultra: '16' };
+     return map[quality] || '18';
+   }
+ 
+   async terminate(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+     if (this.ffmpeg) {
+       try { this.ffmpeg.terminate(); } catch { /* ignore */ }
+       this.ffmpeg = null;
+       this.ffmpegLoaded = false;
+     }
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ export const asciiVideoExportService = new ASCIIVideoExportService();
+

+         // characters, background gets lighter ones. Brightness is preserved as the base
+         // so the output is always visible (never blank).
          if (depthMode) {

+           // depth 0 = FAR → lighter chars but still visible (35% brightness preserved)
+           // depth 1 = NEAR → full brightness, dense heavy chars
+           const depthModulation = 0.35 + 0.65 * depth;
+           avgBrightness = avgBrightness * depthModulation;
+           // Ensure minimum visibility — even far background shows something
+           avgBrightness = Math.max(0.06, avgBrightness);
          }

All 6 tasks are complete. Here's a summary of everything I fixed:

---

## Changes Summary

### 1. **MP4 Export — Fixed** (`src/services/asciiVideoExport.ts`)
- **Primary encoder**: Now uses **WebCodecs API + mp4-muxer** (already installed) for native H.264 encoding — fast, reliable, no WASM download needed
- **Audio muxing**: Uses FFmpeg WASM only for the lightweight task of copying audio from the original file into the MP4 (no video re-encoding)
- **FFmpeg fallback**: If WebCodecs isn't available, falls back to full FFmpeg WASM encode with multi-CDN loading (jsdelivr → unpkg)
- **No more WebM**: Zero WebM code anywhere in the export pipeline

### 2. **Removed WebM Fallback** (`src/pages/ASCIIVideoConverter.tsx`)
- Deleted the entire MediaRecorder/WebM fallback block (~50 lines)
- Clean error messaging if MP4 export fails — no silent fallback to broken WebM
- Duration is now guaranteed correct: WebCodecs uses precise microsecond timestamps (`frameDurationUs = 1_000_000 / fps`)

### 3. **Fixed Neural Depth Mode** (`src/workers/asciiProcessor.worker.ts`)
Two bugs causing blank output:
- **Small block sampling bug**: The `computeBlockDepth` inner loop used `blockStartY + 1` to `blockEndY - 1`, which produced zero iterations for blocks ≤2 pixels wide/tall (common at low resolutions). Fixed to use clamped coordinates starting from `blockStartY`
- **Brightness replacement bug**: Depth value completely replaced brightness (`avgBrightness = depth`), so low-depth areas became spaces. Now depth **modulates** brightness: `avgBrightness = avgBrightness * (0.35 + 0.65 * depth)` — foreground gets dense chars, background stays visible
- S-curve threshold lowered from 0.35 → 0.2 so more content reaches visible range

### 4. **Fixed Preview Scaling** (`src/pages/ASCIIVideoConverter.tsx`)
- Changed container from `overflow: 'hidden'` → `overflow: 'auto'`
- Both colored and monochrome previews now scroll horizontally/vertically so you can see the full ASCII art
- Slightly adjusted `clamp()` font sizing for better fit

### 5. **Added Focal Length Control** (`src/components/SplatViewerControls.tsx` + `src/viewers/ViewerSettingsContext.tsx`)
- Added `fov` to the `ViewerSettings` interface (default: 60°)
- New **Lens** section in the settings sidebar with:
  - **Focal Length slider** (10mm–200mm) with wide/normal/tele labels
  - **FOV slider** (5°–120°) — both linked via 36mm sensor math
- Real-time conversion between focal length and FOV

### 6. **Wired FOV to Both Renderers** (`src/pages/SplatViewerPage.tsx`)
- Added `setFov()` to the `CameraAPI` interface
- **Three.js renderer**: Directly sets `camera.fov` and calls `updateProjectionMatrix()`
- **Gaussian Splat renderer**: Maps FOV to orbit controls radius (zoom proxy)
- Settings changes reactively update the camera via `useEffect` on `settings.fov`
- Initial Canvas FOV now reads from settings: `fov: settings.fov ?? 60`
